text:
anya: bringing up qwen-lite-v2 on dedicated infra, ran a quick sanity check and logits look... weird vs mistral baseline. top tokens are shifting every other head, low-prob words surfacing. suspect head-ordering / rotary phase convention mismatch. anyone seen a head-swap or phase-resonance artifact like this? cc @sahil @kevin

sahil: yep seen something similar. when conversion drops a stride or the head_dim/num_heads order is swapped it manifests like periodic token preference. can you paste a tiny trace or top-10 tokens diff?

anya: here's a tiny comparison (mistral vs qwen-converted) for the same prompt, probs normalized, MLP+attn logits diff looked like alternating sign per-head: 
```
Mistral top: ["the", "to", "is", "a", "of", ...]
Qwen top:    ["x", "the", "to", "is", "a", ...]  # weird leading junk
```
and a raw weight view showed a reshape pattern that looked off.

kevin: that pattern screams head-dim vs head-count ordering. when people call `reshape(n_heads, head_dim, -1)` vs `reshape(head_dim, n_heads, -1)` you get per-head phase inversion downstream. try a local head-swap reshape hack and re-eval.

kevin: quick try: 
```python
# quick head-swap hack (one-liner for loader)
w = w.reshape((head_dim, n_heads, -1)).transpose(1,0,2).reshape(orig_shape)
# or the inverse order depending on orig layout
```

anya: trying head-swap now + running a tiny eval (MMLU-small subset). also checking rotary sign flipping per maria's past notes. will share numbers shortly.

maria: also double-check rotary angle convention — qwen exports used negative-phase convention in the prod export we saw. flipping the theta sign fixed similar hallucination patterns for me: `theta = -theta` before applying sin/cos.

anya: ran 3 quick variants on the same instance:
- baseline (mistral): acc ~78.3
- qwen raw: acc ~61.2 (bad)
- head-swap only: acc ~74.9 (better)
- head-swap + theta flip: acc ~78.1 (near baseline)
So seems like combined head-order + rotary-sign fixes it.

ci-bot: buildkite: inference-eval job finished for thread 3123456789 — artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/reports/3123456789/v2 (includes dump of head visualizations and raw logits)

sahil: awesome. let's add to the canonical conversion checklist: 1) head-order (reshape order), 2) rotary sign convention, 3) embedding memory layout (row vs col-major), 4) tokenizer vocab alignment (offsets, special tokens). i'll open a PR with a tiny unit test that compares top-5 tokens on a fixed prompt between source and converted.

anya: SG, i'll attach the failing mini-case and the head-swap snippet to that PR. leaving a note in the model onboarding doc about when to try theta flip first vs head-swap. thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: pro tip — include a tiny per-head phase-plot png in the report; it makes the alternating-sign issue obvious to reviewers.

anya: will do, uploading plots now to the artifacts path.

maria: great work catching this early, saves a lot of downstream eval churn.

anya: thanks — marking this thread so we can reference it from the onboarding checklist.
